basics.name: Markus Aurich
basics.label: Agentic Engineering Consultant & Fractional CTO
basics.summary:
I help product and engineering teams build the harness and processes to ship better products with AI agents.

I bring agentic engineering into existing product teams: toolchain and conventions, a development cycle with clear human checkpoints, coaching until the leads carry it themselves, and numbers that show whether it works. At Re:Guest I lead this change as Fractional Head of Engineering.

I take the same approach to finance. At Agentic Business Builders we build finance processes that run on their own and hold up in an audit.

I use what I teach. I built Signivo, a production SaaS, fully agentic and run as a real business. Before that I was CTO & CPO at reteach and scaled the product to 300+ customers and a team of 8.

work.summary: Agentic engineering for finance teams. We build finance processes that run on their own and hold up in an audit. My co-founder brings the finance side, from accounting to CFO, I bring the engineering.

work.name: Independent Consulting
highlights: Re:Guest (hospitality SaaS): Agentic Engineering Consultant since 05/2026, Fractional Head of Engineering since 10/2026. Leading the move to agentic engineering in three product divisions: operating model, an agent-first development cycle with human checkpoints, coaching per team, and a cockpit that measures adoption and delivery.

Burger Edelmetalle (precious-metals refiner): agentic engineering rewrite of a business-critical legacy component under bank-grade IT security requirements. Ongoing framework contract for extensions, plus coaching the in-house developers.
Built an AI-powered assessment platform for Outcapped: LLM-driven analysis across 6 business domains, connected to Google Workspace, Gmail, and Notion.
Delivered a touch-optimized industrial control interface for the heating distribution system of a company in the construction sector. Fully built with agentic engineering.
